summary: Intact SDXL, asked for a time other than 10:10, drew hands at 10:10 on 5 of 40 clocks and the asked time on 1. It cannot set a clock, so the asked time could not fail under damage.
Drawing damage strips the numbers first: at the mildest dose the outline survives but 12 numbers in order fall from 33% to 4%.
Language damage removes the whole clock instead (a portrait, a robot, a street), and the clocks it still draws keep their numbers at the intact rate.

janus.summary: The same damage takes both, reading first. With 35% of its language neurons off, Janus reads the right kind for 18% of doodles (intact 85%) and draws the asked kind 36% of the time (intact 78%). Its wheelchair becomes a tricycle, then a car.
